identity.title: ALMA polarization observations of the particle accelerators in the hotspot of the radio galaxy 3C 445
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) polarization observations at 97.5 GHz of the southern hot spot of the radio galaxy 3C 445.

evidence.quote: At the redshift of the target, $z$ = 0.0558, the luminosity distance $D_{\rm L}$ is 252 Mpc, and 1 arcsecond = 1.09 kpc.

distance_source.value: derived from redshift with H0=71, OmegaM=0.27, OmegaL=0.73

question.value: Does the polarization of the 3C 445 South hot spot at 97.5 GHz favour multiple shocks or turbulent second-order Fermi acceleration as the origin of the extended optical emission?

evidence.quote: a clear evidence in support of either the multiple/complex shock scenario or the turbulence model requires deep polarimetric observations in the mm regime
in full polarization (project ID: #2013.1.00286.S)
using the Band 3 receiver (97.5 GHz) in full polarization
The resolution is 0.6 arcsecond.

sensitivity.value: rms 15 uJy/beam Stokes I; 12 uJy/beam Stokes Q and U

evidence.quote: Final images have an rms of 15 $\mu$Jy/beam in Stokes I, and 12 $\mu$Jy/beam in Stokes Q and U.
The target on-source observing time was 2 hr, for a total observing time of 3 hr
The observations were performed on 2015 September 3 and 32 good antennas participated in the observing run.

method.value: CASA calibration with polarization calibrator J2134-0153 for D-terms and cross-hand delay/phase; flux scale from phase calibrator

analysis_steps.goal: Make polarization intensity, angle and fractional polarization maps

method.value: Combine Q and U images; blank fractional polarization where total intensity below 3 times off-source rms

evidence.quote: Blanking on the fractional polarization image was done by clipping the pixels of the total intensity image with values below three times the rms measured on the off-source image plane.

method.value: Matched ALMA and VLA images with same uv-range, resolution, sampling; registered on brightest optically-thin component; 3 sigma blanking

evidence.quote: We produced another set of VLA and ALMA images with the same *uv*-range, resolution and image sampling.

method.value: Polygonal regions for flux densities and polarized flux; errors by propagation with 3% amplitude uncertainty

evidence.quote: are extracted from the same region by selecting polygonal areas.

findings_qualitative.value: Strong polarization in E and W (30-40%) indicates shocks; no polarization in diffuse emission implies tangled field

evidence.quote: Both components show fractional polarization between 30 and 40 per cent, suggesting the presence of shocks.

claims.hypothesis: Are E and W components sites of shock acceleration?
claims.result: 30-40% fractional polarization, EVPA perpendicular to structures
claims.finding: Multiple shock fronts, W polarization may trace front shock

evidence.quote: it may reach peak values as high as 40 and 35 per cent in the E and W component, respectively

claims.hypothesis: Is diffuse emission produced by turbulent Fermi-II acceleration?
claims.experiment: Search for polarization in diffuse emission and spectral index
claims.finding: Disordered field with cells ~160 pc consistent with Fermi-II

evidence.quote: Particles injected in E and W are then transported and possibly reaccelerated downstream in a turbulent magnetic field by Fermi-II mechanisms
